title: Frozen Pre-Registrations of the Authorship Investigation — Append-Only Ledger (PREREG-LEDGER)
creator: Sharks, Lee
description: The frozen pre-registration ledger of the authorship investigation: eleven entries, each carrying the SHA-256 of its original standalone registration file so that every earlier commit citing those hashes still resolves, with dispositions appended beneath each entry and never inside it. Pre-registrations cannot live in the living notebook, because their whole value is that the content was fixed before the test and a hash over an appending file proves nothing; they are gathered here instead of proliferating as three files apiece. The ledger includes the registrations behind the six-function transmission apparatus (EA-YIELD-02) and the completeness gate (EA-COMPLETE-01) that the technical report EA-MEASURES-REPORT-01 cites as fixed before assignment.
substrate: AI-assisted (substrate) — composed in working dialogue with Claude (Anthropic) under operator direction (Lee Sharks); every measurement computed against commit-pinned seated corpora (Perseus canonical-greekLit, First1KGreek, and the comparison corpora named in the file); results recorded with their conditions and refutations beside them; the operator's rulings, retractions and voids are part of the record
axn_reading: Text -> Proof -> Method -> Text -> Method -> Force
wiki_article: The Frozen Pre-Registration Ledger of the authorship investigation is an append-only record of what was fixed before each test was run, gathered in one file so that registrations do not proliferate as separate documents and so that their freeze is checkable. Each of its eleven entries carries the SHA-256 of the original standalone registration file it replaces, so that every earlier commit citing those hashes still resolves; dispositions are appended beneath the entry they discharge and never written inside it. The rule the ledger states of itself is that nothing above a DISPOSITION line is ever edited, and the reason is given: pre-registrations cannot live in an appending notebook, because their whole value is that the content was fixed before the test and a hash taken over a file that grows proves nothing about what it contained when the test was run. Among the entries are the registrations behind the six-function transmission specification and the completeness conditions that the derived technical report cites as fixed before any text was assigned to them, together with entries whose dispositions record that the registered test failed or was withdrawn. It is the companion of the notebook (EA-NOTEBOOK-01), which holds the rounds, and of the measurement register (EA-AUTHORSHIP-MEASURES-01), which holds the figures with their conditions.

entities.subject: Frozen Pre-Registration Ledger
entities.object: Frozen Pre-Registrations of the Authorship Investigation — Append-Only Ledger (PREREG-LEDGER)
entities.note: An append-only document collecting pre-registered hypotheses, where entries are never edited after registration and dispositions are appended beneath each entry rather than inside it, ensuring content was fixed before any test was run.

entities.subject: Leak Deficit
entities.object: Frozen Pre-Registrations of the Authorship Investigation — Append-Only Ledger (PREREG-LEDGER)
entities.note: The hypothesis that a corpus engineered against resolution deposits fewer incidental cross-textual correspondences at the aggregate layer than natural corpora of matched size and register, measurable as a deficit in block-pair cosine similarity exceedances.

entities.subject: Leak (statistic) L
entities.object: Frozen Pre-Registrations of the Authorship Investigation — Append-Only Ledger (PREREG-LEDGER)
entities.note: A one-directional statistic defined as the count of block-pairs whose cosine similarity exceeds a threshold τ, per 10⁴ block-pairs, chosen because it is monotone under smoothing.

entities.subject: Degenerate lower tail
entities.object: Frozen Pre-Registrations of the Authorship Investigation — Append-Only Ledger (PREREG-LEDGER)
entities.note: A condition in which too many null pairs produce exactly zero leak, causing the 5th and 10th percentiles to both equal 0.0, making it impossible for any corpus to fall below the registered threshold.

entities.subject: Spent (registration status)
entities.object: Frozen Pre-Registrations of the Authorship Investigation — Append-Only Ledger (PREREG-LEDGER)
entities.note: A disposition applied to a pre-registration whose kill condition was never triggered because a structural defect was found before the test pair was computed, distinguishing it from a withdrawn or failed registration.

entities.subject: Comparative Interpretive Yield (Y)
entities.object: Frozen Pre-Registrations of the Authorship Investigation — Append-Only Ledger (PREREG-LEDGER)
entities.note: A statistic measuring whether a lens picks out a coherent dimension of variation in a corpus, computed as the z-score of the mean pairwise Pearson correlation of marker densities against a frequency-matched null distribution.

entities.subject: Saturation defect
entities.object: Frozen Pre-Registrations of the Authorship Investigation — Append-Only Ledger (PREREG-LEDGER)
entities.note: A failure mode in which a lens that saturates every work of a corpus shows no variance across works, producing near-zero correlation and therefore near-zero yield, making low yield ambiguous between absence and saturation.

entities.subject: Reorganization Yield
entities.object: Frozen Pre-Registrations of the Authorship Investigation — Append-Only Ledger (PREREG-LEDGER)
entities.note: A revised measure of interpretive yield based on whether a lens reorganizes and develops a corpus according to the lens's own functional slots — assessed via coverage, sharpness, and development — rather than lexical co-variance.

entities.subject: Transmission Engineering Lens
entities.object: Frozen Pre-Registrations of the Authorship Investigation — Append-Only Ledger (PREREG-LEDGER)
entities.note: A six-slot analytical framework (T1 Encoding, T2 Substrate, T3 Decommissioning, T4 Withholding, T5 Recovery, T6 Verification) applied to corpora to measure whether they are organized by a programme of transmitting a voice across time.

entities.subject: Abandoned-Execution Completion
entities.object: Frozen Pre-Registrations of the Authorship Investigation — Append-Only Ledger (PREREG-LEDGER)
entities.note: A diagnostic relation in which a successor corpus finishes operations that the predecessor explicitly abandoned as impossible or aporetic, distinguished from mere correction or extension of completed work.

entities.subject: λόγος-level correction
entities.object: Frozen Pre-Registrations of the Authorship Investigation — Append-Only Ledger (PREREG-LEDGER)
entities.note: A distinction between Aristotle stating that Plato erred (a transmittable statement) versus Aristotle executing the same operation and taking a different branch at the point of decision, which cannot be transmitted as doctrine.

entities.subject: Engineered Unresolvability
entities.object: Frozen Pre-Registrations of the Authorship Investigation — Append-Only Ledger (PREREG-LEDGER)
entities.note: The hypothesis that the Platonic–Aristotelian corpus was deliberately constructed to resist attribution resolution, producing ambiguity that is flat and instrument-invariant rather than uneven as in natural corpora.

entities.subject: Key (of engineered unresolvability)
entities.object: Frozen Pre-Registrations of the Authorship Investigation — Append-Only Ledger (PREREG-LEDGER)
entities.note: A placed signature within an engineered corpus that is prominent, inert under ordinary reading, decisive under the configurational reading, and indicative of making — required because a construction good enough to be undetectable must leave something that confirms it.

entities.subject: Unlocking Prediction
entities.object: Frozen Pre-Registrations of the Authorship Investigation — Append-Only Ledger (PREREG-LEDGER)
entities.note: The claim that structures independently puzzling before the hypothesis was applied will repeatedly become more determinate when Plato and Aristotle are read as positions inside one construction, without altering local philology.

entities.subject: Relational Form Measure
entities.object: Frozen Pre-Registrations of the Authorship Investigation — Append-Only Ledger (PREREG-LEDGER)
entities.note: A three-part measure (R1 Complementary Coverage, R2 Abandoned-Execution Completion, R3 Arbitrary Procedural Agreement) applied to labelled corpus pairs to separate H (one-maker), S (succession), C (collaboration), and I (independent) classes without Greek content.

entities.subject: Complementary Coverage (R1)
entities.object: Frozen Pre-Registrations of the Authorship Investigation — Append-Only Ledger (PREREG-LEDGER)
entities.note: A relational form scored as coverage(A∪B) / max(coverage(A), coverage(B)) against redundancy |A∩B|/|A∪B|, testing whether two corpora are internally tight while their union is materially more complete than either alone.

entities.subject: Arbitrary Procedural Agreement (R3)
entities.object: Frozen Pre-Registrations of the Authorship Investigation — Append-Only Ledger (PREREG-LEDGER)
entities.note: A relational form scoring shared habits that the method does not require, defined generically and scored on independent works only to avoid shared-source contamination.

entities.subject: Contamination Rule
entities.object: Frozen Pre-Registrations of the Authorship Investigation — Append-Only Ledger (PREREG-LEDGER)
entities.note: A methodological rule distinguishing commentary works (where R3 is inadmissible due to shared-source contamination) from independent works (where all three relational forms are admissible), applied per pair.

entities.subject: Specification-Depth Hypothesis
entities.object: Frozen Pre-Registrations of the Authorship Investigation — Append-Only Ledger (PREREG-LEDGER)
entities.note: The hypothesis that container tightness in a corpus tracks the severity of constraint placed on a speaking position, not similarity or disguise, so that ratio of internal dispersion to inter-position distance orders by how much was subtracted from a fully unspecified voice.

entities.subject: Reception Capture
entities.object: Frozen Pre-Registrations of the Authorship Investigation — Append-Only Ledger (PREREG-LEDGER)
entities.note: A score measuring the degree to which an interpreter's distinctive vocabulary is already present in the interpreted position, computed as the median rate ratio of the interpreter's top distinctive terms found in the interpreted text, with the term set selected without reference to the interpreted position.

entities.subject: Unit-level variation (L1–L4)
entities.object: Frozen Pre-Registrations of the Authorship Investigation — Append-Only Ledger (PREREG-LEDGER)
entities.note: A scoring scheme for the Reorganization Yield measure across four granularities: L1 individual book/work, L2 author-group, L3 whole corpus, L4 cross-corpus, based on the principle that a lens may organize at one level and not another.

entities.subject: SPXI Layer 4 cross-signing graph
entities.object: Frozen Pre-Registrations of the Authorship Investigation — Append-Only Ledger (PREREG-LEDGER)
entities.note: The archive layer that records cross-references between deposits, populated by entries in the CHA cross-references array.

entities.subject: Instrument-invariance (A1)
entities.object: Frozen Pre-Registrations of the Authorship Investigation — Append-Only Ledger (PREREG-LEDGER)
entities.note: An observable for engineered unresolvability: whether unrelated instruments return the same non-answer, measured against a comparison class of natural corpora.

entities.subject: Reverse-engineering test
entities.object: Frozen Pre-Registrations of the Authorship Investigation — Append-Only Ledger (PREREG-LEDGER)
entities.note: A binding scoring rule requiring that an UNLOCK count only if the resolving passage was not found by open search; any case found by open search is scored NULL regardless of quality.

entities.subject: Preconditions (binding, pre-run)
entities.object: Frozen Pre-Registrations of the Authorship Investigation — Append-Only Ledger (PREREG-LEDGER)
entities.note: A set of three conditions (non-degeneracy, spread, size) that must all hold on the null alone before the test pair may be computed; if any fail, the registration is spent and a new one is required.
